name: Crimson Fate
source:
In the ashes of her burning village, Elara Kane — a gentle baker — is cornered by vampires. 

Instead of death, she receives something far more dangerous which is the lingering, sensual bite of Lilith Voss, the cold but conflicted Commander of the vampire fleet.

Taken to Lilith’s lavish gothic bedchamber, Elara finds herself trapped between fear, anger, and an undeniable attraction to the very woman who destroyed her home.

[From [url=https://witch-fleurdelis.itch.io/crimson-fate]itch.io[/url]]
